question: Who was sworn in as the Governor of Chhattisgarh in February 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Biswabhusan Harichandan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Biswabhusan Harichandan was sworn in as the Governor of Chhattisgarh on **February 23, 2023**.
 
• He succeeded **Anusuiya Uikey**, who served as the previous Governor of Chhattisgarh.
 
• Biswabhusan Harichandan is a senior BJP leader and former Governor of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The swearing-in ceremony took place at **Raj Bhavan, Raipur**, administered by the Chief Justice of the Chhattisgarh High Court.
 
• Harichandan has a long political career and has held various positions, including serving as a minister in Odisha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Governor's Role in Indian States:**

 
 
• The Governor is the **constitutional head of a state** and acts as a representative of the President of India.
 
• Appointed by the President, the Governor's tenure is generally **five years**, but they can serve at the pleasure of the President.
 
• Key functions include **approving bills passed by the state legislature, appointing the Chief Minister, and overseeing state administration.**
 
 
 
• **Biswabhusan Harichandan's Political Career:**
 
 
• He is a veteran leader of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) with over five decades of political experience.
 
• Harichandan has served as **Cabinet Minister in Odisha**, holding portfolios such as Law, Revenue, and Rural Development.
 
• He was previously the Governor of Andhra Pradesh (2019-2023) before his appointment to Chhattisgarh.
 
 
 
• **Chhattisgarh State Overview:**
 
 
• Chhattisgarh was formed on **November 1, 2000**, by bifurcating Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The state is rich in **mineral resources**, including coal, iron ore, and bauxite.
 
• Raipur is the capital of Chhattisgarh, and the state is known for its tribal heritage and culture.
 
 
 
• **Constitutional Provisions for Governors:**
 
 
• The Governor's powers and responsibilities are outlined in **Articles 153-162** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Governors have both **executive and legislative powers**, including granting pardons and promulgating ordinances.
